concerns.text: The sensitivity analysis relies on only three random seeds per (model, dataset) combination. With such a small number of replicates the paired‑test comparisons (Phase 6) and the estimation of false‑positive/false‑negative rates lack sufficient statistical power to detect modest but practically important differences between generators. This undermines SC‑005 (computational‑time) and SC‑002/SC‑004 stability claims.
